description: This file contains helper functions for testing and configuration management in the openclaw project, including functions to handle temporary home directories, write configuration files, override environment variables, and build web search provider configurations.

methods.name: withTempHome
methods.description: Creates a temporary home directory, resets config state before and after executing a callback.

methods.name: writeOpenClawConfig
methods.description: Writes the given configuration object to a JSON file in the user's home directory.

methods.name: writeStateDirDotEnv
methods.description: Creates a .env file with specified content in the state directory, which is determined from parameters or environment variables.

methods.name: withTempHomeConfig
methods.description: Sets up a temporary home directory with a specific configuration, then runs a callback.

methods.name: withEnvOverride
methods.description: Overrides environment variables temporarily for the duration of a callback, restoring them afterward.

methods.name: buildWebSearchProviderConfig
methods.description: Builds a configuration object for a web search provider, with optional enabling and custom provider configuration.
